en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural village street. A large two‑storey inn stands on the right side with a gabled facade, several windows and painted signage on the wall. Fenced gardens and trees line the dirt road. A few children stand along the street in front of the fences. Printed German text at the top names the village and describes the street and inn, and signage on the building identifies the guesthouse.
